supportedEnvironments: local: macOS, Linux and Windows with SQLite (CI matrix)
hosted path: Linux container with Postgres 18 (flint-forge image), Ory Kratos and flint-gate, verified via local Docker stand-ins
releaseClaim.userOperation: A hosted operator runs Sellbird against its own database on the shared flint-forge Postgres 18 and signs in through Kratos and flint-gate; a local user keeps running on SQLite with the token link unchanged. In this phase the hosted path is proven against local real-service stand-ins; the live public deployment is carried to the platform phase.

requiredSafetyChecks.description: Approval default, quiet hours, daily limits, opt-outs and exactly-once claiming are preserved on both backends
Unknown signal codes are rejected on both backends
The dashboard token and AI credential never appear in logs or files
Gateway mode is config-selected; only a verified gate JWT for an allowlisted identity is admitted; cookies and unverified headers are ignored
The runtime database role cannot change schema
No real hostname or registry literal in this public fork's manifests

resilienceScope.policy: Adopted requirements never defer via budget overflow; exhaustion means checkpoint and BLOCKED. Only never-adopted optional items may defer.
